title: Mark To Do As Done in To Do
description: Complete the mark to do as done workflow in the To Do module using a validated, repeatable process.

You can open the To Do module in the current Ogeemo environment.
Required data inputs for mark to do as done are prepared before starting.
steps: Open the To Do module from the main navigation.
Locate the mark to do as done entry point in the module workflow.
Enter or select the required inputs for mark to do as done.
Review the configuration and confirm all required fields are complete.
Run or save the workflow and wait for confirmation feedback.
Record output artifacts and references for audit and follow-up tasks.
validations: Mark To Do As Done completes without warnings or blockers.

recovery: Validate required field inputs and rerun mark to do as done.

faq.question: When should I rerun mark to do as done?
faq.answer: Rerun after correcting inputs or permissions, then validate output against expected records.

faq.question: How do I confirm mark to do as done is complete?
faq.answer: Use module validation checks, confirm resulting records, and verify supporting artifacts were saved.
